bench: lo_ext_pad.py: external LO through the drawn pads: refpad (tx_protected_pad, VCM=VDD/2) on REF_IN (I), rf_protected_pad debug pair on AUX_CLK (Q)
criteria: f within 1 %; RX switch Vgs (source at the mixer VCM = VDD/2) on >= 0.9 V and off <= 0.5 V for both I and Q, judged on the steady-state projection (avg(LO) = VB(t=0); measured waveform kept about it); 80 < |Q-I| < 100 deg (differential zero crossings)
package_model: board 50 ohm source + 10 pF C0G per leg (B19); bond wire 1.5 nH + 0.2 ohm per leg (B21; 1.0/2.0 nH in bondwire_*); 0.1 pF pad-to-pad
pads: REF_IN (I): refpad tx_protected_pad, VCM = VDD/2 (stress-safe-families/reference/physical.spice); AUX_CLK (Q): rf_protected_pad debug pair; both with the disabled extracted diff_clk_rx
settle_note: settle_*: long runs at ss/32/3.15, 3 Vpp. The 200 ns run used the previous lo_ext (VB = 0.773 VDD), the 300 ns run the current one (0.716 VDD). VB and the LO DC recover towards VB(t=0) with ~200 ns time constants, which is what the steady-state projection assumes; the pad DC is still rising at the end.
